appearance_facts.fact: A blue line connects dark blue circular markers, starting at the top left and ending at the bottom right.
The line remains near the top edge of the chart from the left margin until approximately the 25% mark of the x-axis.
After the initial flat section, the line slopes steeply downward toward the bottom right corner.
A light blue shaded region fills the space between the blue line and the bottom edge of the plot area.
The vertical position of the markers moves progressively lower on the page from left to right.
The markers in the right half of the chart are positioned significantly lower on the page than those in the left half.
The final marker on the far right is the lowest point of the line on the page.
The slope of the line is negative throughout the majority of the x-axis span.

printed_facts.fact: Title reads 'Month vs. Number of cases'.
Y-axis is labeled 'Count' with tick marks numbered 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, and 1400 from top to bottom.
X-axis displays date labels ranging from 'Jan 27, 2020' to 'Mar 22, 2020'.
The numeric values on the y-axis increase as you move down the page (0 at top, 1400 at bottom).
The date labels are rotated diagonally.

uncertain: The specific numerical value of the cases at each data point is not labeled directly on the markers.
The exact start and end dates of the reporting period are defined by the first and last visible tick labels.
